name: @jbbz-sandbox/sandbox-cli
description: Multi-feature concurrent development orchestrator CLI tool
//files: dist/ is gitignored build output, and npm drops gitignored paths unless an explicit list opts them back in. That opt-in is indiscriminate, so the negations below put back the exclusions that matter — above all tmp/kubeconfig, which `sandbox connect` fills with live cluster credentials. Everything negated here is regenerated by `sandbox connect` on the installing machine.
//dependencies: Everything else is bundled by esbuild.mjs — see its docstring. dockerode stays external because its ssh2 -> cpu-features requires must be allowed to fail into a pure-JS fallback, and ESM output turns an unresolved require into a shim that throws instead.
